name: The Library Without Doors
description:
The shelves were full, but access belonged to the institution. Its keys, subscriptions, and opening hours decided which stories could be read. When the keeper left, knowledge waited behind a locked door.

The door is laid down and becomes a reading platform. Books leave the shelves. The record can be found, read, and carried forward by people the original keeper never knew.

attributes.value: Painted steel · bound paper · ivory ceramic
